description: This Java class EnableProfileActivity manages the enabling of a managed profile on an Android device post-provisioning. It interacts with the DevicePolicyManager to set profile properties and handles user interactions to navigate to the main activity.

classes.name: EnableProfileActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that enables a managed profile after provisioning and facilitates user navigation to the main activity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and enables the profile if not restoring from saved state.

methods.name: enableProfile
methods.description: Uses DevicePolicyManager to set the profile name and enable the managed profile.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on the view, specifically to launch the main activity.
